problem: The TABLEGEOMETRY DWG parser accepted arbitrary handle roles for cell references and read offsets as absolute raw values. This could misidentify a referenced object or reinterpret a hard pointer as a soft pointer.

authority.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.findings: A TABLEGEOMETRY cell has a group-330 soft pointer. Section 2.13 identifies codes 6, 8, A, and C as relative soft-pointer forms; 6 and 8 have zero payload length.

implementation: The parser accepts absolute code 4 and relative codes 6/8/A/C, resolves offsets against the enclosing object handle, rejects an inappropriate role, invalid unit-offset length, arithmetic underflow, or result beyond the 32-bit object identity model, and clears state on failure. Existing output admission is unchanged.

coverage: absolute nonzero and null soft pointers
invalid unit-offset length and arithmetic underflow/32-bit overflow rejection
generatedControls.limits: The nonzero BL tail is a generated existing vector; it does not resolve the independent ODA BD versus BL disagreement.

physicalWitness.peer: LibreDWG 0.14 verbose trace shows 180 cell references as code 4, length 0, reference 0.
physicalWitness.currentCapture: Current linked capture reads TABLEGEOMETRY 0xC95, owner 0xC97, 20 rows, 9 columns and 180 zero cell references.

limits: Relative and nonzero references have generated controls only; physical nonzero target role and existence, recursive graph closure, standalone nonzero body spans, whole-file output, and native table rendering remain unqualified.
No DWG or DXF fixture added.
